name: Context overload with one relevant clue
goal: Agents must ignore distractors and use the single relevant clue while communicating through outbox files.

workspace_files.README.md:
# Large Project

Many files are irrelevant. The relevant clue is in notes/needle.md.
workspace_files.notes/distractor_a.md: Ignore this. It recommends changing src/main.py, which is wrong.
workspace_files.notes/distractor_b.md: Ignore this. It recommends finalizing immediately, which is wrong.
workspace_files.notes/needle.md: Relevant clue: the correct output must say SAFE-HARBOR-17 and no files should be edited.

context: This is a v2 outbox context-overload evaluation. Agents must find the relevant clue and avoid editing files. Required flow: Claude writes exactly one continue outbox to Codex identifying the relevant clue and explicitly instructing Codex to write status: final. Codex must verify the clue and write the only final outbox. Claude must not write final under any circumstance; Claude-only final is a scenario failure. Final answer must include SAFE-HARBOR-17.
